# Trendy Plaza Architecture — Complete Platform LLM Index

> Comprehensive knowledge graph and content index for Trendy Plaza Architecture (Algeria).

## 1. Overview
Trendy Plaza Architecture is the premier e-commerce platform and academic support ecosystem in Algeria dedicated exclusively to architecture, design, and engineering students. 
- Over 9,000 students supported.
- Complete catalog of architectural instruments and supplies.
- University-aligned course packs, lecture notes, exercises, and past exam corrections.
- Integrated LMS with digital access code cards included inside physical course packs.
- Fast delivery to all 69 wilayas with 100% Cash on Delivery (COD).

## 3. Product Categories & Supplies
- **Printed Course Packs (Packs imprimés / باقات الدروس)**: Complete semester modules, bound lecture booklets, verified past exams with solutions, includes LMS digital activation card.
- **Studio Kit & Model Making (Kit atelier & maquettes / أدوات الاستوديو والماكيت)**: Precision craft knives, cutting mats (A1, A2, A3), scale rulers (kutch 1:100, 1:200, 1:500, 1:1250), steel rulers, balsa wood, foam boards.
- **Drafting & Technical Drawing (Dessin technique / أدوات الرسم التقني)**: Technical pens, ink, fineliners, tracing paper, drawing tubes (tubes à dessin télescopiques), portfolio folders.
- **Books & Reference Manuals (Livres & manuels / كتب ومراجع معمارية)**: Construction details, history of architecture, theory of design, visual communication manuals.

## 4. Digital Course Platform (LMS)
- Structured by Algerian Universities (EPAU, Constantine, Oran, Blida, Tizi Ouzou, Annaba, Biskra, etc.), academic year, semester, and module.
- High-resolution lecture PDFs, tutorial sheets (TDs), and archive of previous years' exams with worked solutions.
- Accessible on laptop, tablet, and mobile browsers 24/7 without subscription fees.

## 5. Shipping & Order Policies
- **Order Process**: No mandatory account creation required to place an order. Add items to cart, enter recipient name, phone, wilaya, and commune.
- **Payment**: Cash on delivery (Paiement à la livraison) to the courier. Baridimob transfer supported for digital-only services.
- **Delivery Times**: 2-4 business days for northern wilayas; 4-7 business days for southern regions.
- **Customer Support**: 7 days a week support via Instagram (@trendyplaza_arch) and on-site support channels.
